name: Scripts
manage.detail: Create, edit and run saved PowerShell or CMD scripts
manage.hint: Save a script, then search its name or alias in the launcher. Execution opens a terminal.
empty: No scripts yet. Click + to create one.
field.name: Name
directory.hint: Optional absolute path; defaults to your home directory
delete.hint: Click Confirm delete to permanently remove this script.
unsaved: Save or discard your changes before switching scripts or closing the window.
missing: Script no longer exists; search again.
validation.name: Enter a name (up to 256 bytes).
validation.alias: Alias must be a single line, up to 128 bytes.
validation.content: Enter script content (up to 64 KiB, no null characters).
validation.directory: Working directory must be an existing absolute directory.
validation.duplicate: Another script already uses this alias.
store.limit: Script store exceeds the supported size limit.
store.invalid: Script store contains invalid or duplicate IDs.
store.conflict: This script was changed in another window. Reopen the manager before editing again.
platform.unsupported: PowerShell and CMD execution is currently supported on Windows only.
